title: Integration of Multidimensional Genetic and Single- Cell Analyses to Identify Potential Drug Targets and a Clinical Risk Prediction Model for Cervical Cancer
summary: Integrated genetic, transcriptomic and single-cell analyses used machine-learning feature selection and Mendelian-randomization evidence to identify cervical-cancer-associated genes and candidate therapeutic targets; the preprint reports specific gene associations, not established treatment effects.
